help: The hidden monster. It is a team clock, not a punishment: there is no game over. Speeds are in tiles per second (players walk at 4.5). Times are in seconds. 'setback' is the chance (0 to 1) that a player hit by a shot drops an item. 'returns' says how the monster comes back after the Slayer chases it away: weaker, same or stronger.

anger.help: Anger goes from 0 to 100. Below 'chaseAt' the monster wanders; from there it chases; from 'shootAt' it shoots. The other numbers are added to the anger when that happens (negative = calmer). After 'idleAfter' seconds without anybody using an ability, anger grows twice as fast.
